headline: Second Class liquor license application for Burlington Asian Market Vermont LLC at 1 Intervale Avenue, plus 2026-2027 liquor license renewals.
summary: The meeting will consider renewals of First and Third Class liquor licenses for 2026-2027. It will also consider a Second Class liquor license application for Burlington Asian Market Vermont LLC at 1 Intervale Avenue.
items: Consent agenda: approve 2026-2027 First and Third Class liquor license renewals as listed in the attached list, with all standard conditions
Deliberative agenda: approve the 2026-2027 Second Class liquor license application for Burlington Asian Market Vermont LLC, 1 Intervale Avenue, with all standard conditions
